title: automate-kms-hsm-tls-rotation-private-installer-helm-terraform
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Automated rotation for TLS certificates and KMS/HSM keys for Private installer: new operator and helm hooks, Terraform module updates for KMS IAM binding, rollout/rollback hooks. Backwards compatible when managed via `rotation.enabled=false`.
description: Context: Customers running Redwood Private require automated secrets and certificate rotation workflows to meet audit and compliance requirements (KMS/HSM-backed keys, Vault/sealed-secrets integration, and TLS cert rotation). This PR implements orchestration across the Private installer, Helm charts, and Terraform modules to enable automated KMS/HSM key rotation, TLS certificate renewal, and safe rollout/rollback. What changed (high level): added a new rotation controller (K8s operator) to the private-installer chart; introduced Helm pre/post hooks for safe canary rollouts during cert replacement; updated the Terraform module to create IAM policies and grant HSM/KMS encryption keys to the installer service account; added Vault and sealed-secrets templates plus a one-shot job for initial key sealing; implemented upgrade/rollback hooks and a CLI flag to opt out of automation. Commits (summary): 1) add rotation controller scaffold + CRD + basic reconciliation loop (controller.go, crd.yaml) 2) helm: add hooks for pre-upgrade backup-job, post-upgrade cert-sync job, chart values to toggle automation; update templates for secrets and serviceaccount RBAC 3) terraform: kms/iam module updates (kms_bindings.tf, variables), hsm provider wiring and examples 4) vault/sealed-secrets: templates and docs for initial seal/unseal flow 5) e2e/fix: tests for rotation controller, fix race in deployment during rolling update Files changed (representative): charts/private-installer/values.yaml, charts/private-installer/templates/rotation-controller-deploy.yaml, charts/private-installer/templates/hooks/pre-upgrade-backup.yaml, charts/private-installer/templates/hooks/post-upgrade-sync.yaml, terraform/modules/kms/iam_bindings.tf, terraform/examples/hsm-kms-with-installer.tf, k8s/crds/rotation.crd.yaml, installer/cmd/rotatectl/main.go, docs/private-installer/rotation.md, tests/e2e/rotation_test.go Testing & CI: CI run summary: unit tests passed; linting passed; integration tests initially failed on e2e/rotation_test.py (flaky timing around KV cache warmup), rerun of the integration stage passed. End-to-end upgrade test on a minimal cluster: successful with canary disabled and successful with canary enabled in 2/2 test runs. Security scan (static) flagged missing KMS IAM binding in a corner case which was resolved in terraform commit 3. Review conversation (high level): - Liam Chen: requested clarification on failure modes during partial rotate (asked for explicit rollback plan and metrics to detect failed rotate). Author responded with added health-check probes and explicit rollback hook that restores previous certs from pre-upgrade backup. - Daniel Kim: asked for tighter RBAC scope for the controller; author updated service account and KMS IAM policy to least-privilege. - Sofia Martinez: requested docs and upgrade notes; author added docs/private-installer/rotation.md and an upgrade checklist. - QA: asked for longer e2e timeout; tests extended accordingly. After fixes, reviewers approved. Upgrade/rollback notes: The chart exposes values.rotation.enabled (default: true). For air-gapped/regulated installs set rotation.enabled=false to keep previous behavior. During upgrade the Helm pre-upgrade hook creates an encrypted backup of TLS keys to a sealed secret (or to Vault if configured). The post-upgrade hook performs a staged cert issuance and switches traffic after health checks succeed. Rollback hooks restore the backed-up secrets and perform a short window where both certs are accepted. The Terraform changes are backward compatible but require a one-time apply for the KMS bindings when enabling automation. Security considerations: KMS/HSM keys are never exported in plaintext. Where Vault is used, the installer supports KMS-wrapping of Vault master keys and uses sealed-secrets to store encrypted payloads. HSM integration uses the provider shim; documentation lists supported HSM models and operational instructions for key import and rotation frequency. Docs & examples: Added detailed docs and a sample terraform/hsm example that walks through grant creation, rotation frequency config, and rollback steps. Release impact & follow ups: This is a backwards-compatible feature flag gated change; recommended to include in next patch release for private-installer and call out automation in customer upgrade emails. Follow-ups: metrics/alerting for rotation failures (ENG-1481), add automatic Linear ticket creation on persistent rotation failures (ENG-1540).
notes_from_merge: Merged after approvals from Liam Chen, Daniel Kim, and Sofia Martinez. CI green on final run. Squashed commits into single change. Tagged release notes for next patch. Post-merge tasks: coordinate with account teams for customers with managed KMS/HSM to schedule rotations and run the one-time terraform apply.
safety_checks: Health checks added to controller, pre-upgrade backup ensures atomic restore, RBAC and IAM bindings scoped to minimum required permissions, integration tests for canary and rollback paths added.
